name: SSR mcap-accel washout long (defensive minting overshoot rolls over)
rationale: MECHANISM: during a drawdown, panic rotation into stables ACCELERATES stablecoin_mcap (defensive minting) while price craters; that defensive flow is late and forced, and it exhausts. This variant enters long when stablecoin_mcap is rising fast (defensive rotation peaking) AND price is deeply oversold on RSI — betting the last forced sellers have arrived. Distinct from variant 01 (which waits for price to turn) and 02 (which reads thin turnover): here the trigger is the defensive-minting surge coinciding with an RSI washout. Other side = capitulating holders minting/moving into stables at the lows. DISCONFIRMER: if removing the stablecoin_mcap acceleration condition and keeping only the RSI washout gives the same net-of-fees edge, the mint surge is inert and this is a plain oversold bounce. Kill if the effect only appears pre-2024 (payments-driven minting now contaminates the mcap signal, corr ~0.4 in 2025-2026).
catalyst: defensive stablecoin minting surge into a deeply oversold price
